text:
Asha: Quick spike result: grouping Settings / Integrations under a Settings group reduces top-level clutter. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/settings-group.png
Noah: Sounds good. Two practical things: deep links must still land correctly (eg /integrations/stripe) and screen readers should be informed when the group expands.
Riley: Agreed. Proposal: canonical path stays /integrations/:id, client hydrates route -> finds sidebar node -> expands parent groups -> focuses link on initial load only. No hash fragments.
Asha: Accessibility: header must be a button with aria-expanded, and we should call live-region announce "Settings expanded". Honor prefers-reduced-motion for animations.
Noah: Breadcrumbs should be humanized: Settings > Integrations > Stripe (not 'Settings group' repeated). Also normalize trailing slashes on server-side.
Riley: Edge case: overlapping slugs between groups. Tie-breaker = longest prefix then sidebar order. Add unit tests for focus and aria toggles.
Design-Bot: Reminder: add annotated flows to Figma and bring to review tomorrow 10:00am.
Asha: I'll draft the PR describing the routing contract, focus rules, ARIA semantics, and test plan. Tagging @Noah and @Riley for review.
Noah: :thumbsup:
Riley: :eyes: Thanks
